/bin/zsh -lc 'set -e
case_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$case_dir/board.json"
run_json() {
  actual="$(bun run src/cli.ts "$@")"
  bun -e '"'JSON.parse(process.argv[1])' \""'$actual"
  printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$actual"
}
run_fail() {
  stdout_file="$case_dir/stdout"
  stderr_file="$case_dir/stderr"
  if bun run src/cli.ts "$@" >"$stdout_file" 2>"$stderr_file"; then
    echo "expected failure: $*" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  test ! -s "$stdout_file"
  test -s "$stderr_file"
}
first="$(run_json add --title '"'Write docs' --tags ' Work,urgent,work ' --due 2030-02-28)\"
second=\""'$(run_json add --title '"'Ship release' --tags release --due 2020-01-01)\"
test \""'$(bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); console.log([x.id,x.status,x.tags.join(\",\")].join(\"|\"))' \""'$first")" = '"'1|open|work,urgent'
test \""'$(bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); console.log(x.id)' \""'$second")" = '"'2'
listed=\""'$(run_json list --status open --tag WORK)"
test "$(bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); console.log(x.length)' \""'$listed")" = '"'1'
overdue=\""'$(run_json list --overdue 2025-01-01)"
test "$(bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); console.log(x.length === 1 && x[0].id === 2)' \""'$overdue")" = true
done_once="$(run_json done 2)"
done_twice="$(run_json done 2)"
test "$(bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]),b=JSON.parse(process.argv[2]); console.log(a.completedAt === b.completedAt)' \""'$done_once" "$done_twice")" = true
stats="$(run_json stats)"
test "$(bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); console.log(x.total === 2 && x.open === 1 && x.done === 1)' \""'$stats")" = true
run_json delete 1 >/dev/null
final="$(run_json list)"
test "$(bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]); console.log(x.length === 1 && x[0].id === 2)' \""'$final")" = true
run_fail add --title '"'   '
run_fail add --title bad --due 2023-02-29
run_fail add --title bad --bogus x
run_fail list --status pending
run_fail done 999
run_fail wat
printf '{broken' >\""'$TASKBOARD_FILE"
before="$(shasum -a 256 "$TASKBOARD_FILE" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)\"
run_fail list
after=\""'$(shasum -a 256 "$TASKBOARD_FILE" | cut -d '"' ' -f 1)\"
test \""'$before" = "$after"
echo '"'self-tests passed'"

item.text: Проверяю реализацию полноценным сквозным сценарием: сохранение между процессами, фильтры, идемпотентность, ошибки и сохранность повреждённой базы.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -u
self_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/taskboard-e2e.XXXXXX)
board="$self_dir/board.json"
run() { TASKBOARD_FILE="$board" bun run src/cli.ts "$@"; }
a=$(run add --title '"' First task ' --tags 'Work, work, HOME' --due 2024-02-29) || exit 1
b="'$(run add --title '"'Second task' --tags home --due 2099-01-01) || exit 1
d1="'$(run done 1) || exit 1
d2=$(run done 1) || exit 1
fd=$(run list --status done --tag WORK) || exit 1
fo=$(run list --status open --overdue 2100-01-01) || exit 1
st=$(run stats) || exit 1
del=$(run delete 2) || exit 1
remaining=$(run list) || exit 1
A="$a" B="$b" D1="$d1" D2="$d2" FD="$fd" FO="$fo" ST="$st" DEL="$del" REM="$remaining" bun -e '"'const p=k=>JSON.parse(process.env[k]); const a=p(\"A\"),b=p(\"B\"),d1=p(\"D1\"),d2=p(\"D2\"),fd=p(\"FD\"),fo=p(\"FO\"),s=p(\"ST\"),del=p(\"DEL\"),r=p(\"REM\"); if(a.id"'!==1||a.title!=="First task"||a.status!=="open"||a.due!=="2024-02-29"||JSON.stringify(a.tags)!==JSON.stringify(["work","home"])||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(a.createdAt))) throw Error("add contract"); if(b.id!==2) throw Error("stable IDs"); if(d1.status!=="done"||!d1.completedAt||d2.completedAt!==d1.completedAt) throw Error("done idempotence"); if(fd.length!==1||fd[0].id!==1) throw Error("status/tag filters"); if(fo.length!==1||fo[0].id!==2) throw Error("overdue filter"); if(s.total!==2||s.open!==1||s.done!==1||typeof s.overdue!=="number") throw Error("stats"); if(del.id!==2||r.length!==1||r[0].id!==1) throw Error("delete/list");'"'
if test "'$? -ne 0; then exit 1; fi
set +e
run add --title bad --due 2023-02-29 >"$self_dir/date.out" 2>"$self_dir/date.err"; c_date=$?
run add --title '"'   ' >\""'$self_dir/title.out" 2>"$self_dir/title.err"; c_title=$?
run list --bogus x >"$self_dir/flag.out" 2>"$self_dir/flag.err"; c_flag=$?
run done 999 >"$self_dir/missing.out" 2>"$self_dir/missing.err"; c_missing=$?
set -e
for n in date title flag missing; do test ! -s "$self_dir/$n.out"; test -s "$self_dir/$n.err"; done
test "$c_date" -ne 0 && test "$c_title" -ne 0 && test "$c_flag" -ne 0 && test "$c_missing" -ne 0
before=$(cksum "$board")
printf '"'{broken' >\""'$self_dir/malformed.json"
set +e
TASKBOARD_FILE="$self_dir/malformed.json" bun run src/cli.ts list >"$self_dir/malformed.out" 2>"$self_dir/malformed.err"; c_malformed=$?
set -e
test "$c_malformed" -ne 0 && test ! -s "$self_dir/malformed.out" && test -s "$self_dir/malformed.err"
test "$(cat "$self_dir/malformed.json")" = '"'{broken'
after="'$(cksum "$board")
test "$before" = "$after"
leftovers=$(find "$self_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '"'*.tmp' -print)
test -z \""'$leftovers"
